verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any stealth or undetected browser mode, fingerprint management, or bot-detection evasion. The only nearby claim is marketing copy that CAPTCHAs and login prompts are 'handled.' Solving challenges is a different feature from running undetected, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems
